homepage_intro: The seasonal menu changes every month or so. Here’s what’s in the case for fall.
menu_intro: Fall flavors, in the shop while they last. The pumpkin spice cake is also on the ordering site.

items.name: Pumpkin spice cake
items.description: Whole or sliced. Spiced pumpkin cake layered with cinnamon cream cheese, topped with cream cheese dollops.
items.photo_description: Pumpkin spice cake with cream cheese dollops and little pumpkins, held in front of green floral wallpaper

items.name: Maple bacon scone
items.description: A buttery maple scone, packed with bacon and spices.
items.photo_description: Maple bacon scones on a pink background

items.name: Pumpkin pop tart
items.description: Flaky pop tart crust, spiced pumpkin filling, brown sugar cinnamon glaze.
items.short: Flaky, buttery crust, spiced pumpkin, brown sugar cinnamon glaze.
items.photo_description: Rows of pumpkin pop tarts with glaze and sprinkles on a pale pink background

items.name: Maple pecan pound cake
items.description: Maple cinnamon pound cake with chopped pecans and sweet maple glaze.
items.short: Maple cinnamon pound cake, chopped pecans, sweet maple glaze.
items.photo_description: Maple pecan pound cake slices with glaze on a teal background

items.name: apple & honey oat bar
items.description: Baked apples and oats, drizzled with honey glaze.
items.photo_description: Apple and honey oat bars with glaze on a teal background

items.name: Pumpkin bread
items.description: Whole or sliced. Fresh-baked spiced pumpkin bread.
items.photo_description: Slices of pumpkin bread on a yellow background

items.name: brown butter s’mores cookie
items.description: Gluten-friendly chocolate chip base, mini marshmallows, graham cracker, ganache drizzle.
items.short: Our gluten-friendly chocolate chip base with marshmallow, graham and ganache.
items.photo_description: Gluten-friendly brown butter s’mores cookies with marshmallow and chocolate drizzle

items.name: pumpkin streusel muffin
items.description: A fluffy pumpkin spice muffin with streusel crumble.
items.photo_description: Gluten-friendly pumpkin streusel muffins on a pink background

items.name: Apple butter brownie
items.description: Fudgy chocolate brownie, cinnamon buttercream, apple butter, spiced streusel and salted caramel drizzle.
items.short: Fudgy brownie, cinnamon buttercream, apple butter, streusel, salted caramel.
items.photo_description: Apple butter brownies topped with streusel and caramel on a pink background
